# Command reference

70 commands. Every user action is a command: the menus, the CLI (`forge cmd`), RPC (`command.run`), MCP (one tool per command, name with `.` replaced by `_`) and scripts (`run(id, #{...})`) all run the same handlers. Angles are degrees, percentages as shown, node ids are integers.

## `object`

### `object.create`

Create. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | yes | Node type id, e.g. `forge.cube`. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.create --args '{"type":"forge.cube"}'`

### `object.delete`

Delete. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Node ids; the current selection when absent. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.delete --args '{"nodes":[1]}'`

### `object.rename`

Rename. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | integer | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.rename --args '{"name":"Box","node":1}'`

### `object.reparent`

Move. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | integer | yes |  |
| `parent` | integer or null | no | New parent; null moves to the root level. Appended as the last child. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.reparent --args '{"node":2,"parent":1}'`

### `object.move`

Move Objects. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `index` | integer or null | no | Position among the parent's children without the moved nodes; absent = last. |
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Nodes to move; the current selection when absent. |
| `parent` | integer or null | no | New parent; null or absent moves to the root level. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.move --args '{"index":0,"nodes":[2,3],"parent":1}'`

### `object.group`

Group Objects. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string or null | no | Name of the new group (default "Null"). |
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Nodes to group; the current selection when absent. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.group --args '{"name":"Group","nodes":[2,3]}'`

### `object.visibility`

Visibility. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `editor` | `"on"` \| `"off"` \| string \| null | no | Editor (viewport) visibility. |
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Nodes to change; the current selection when absent. |
| `render` | `"on"` \| `"off"` \| string \| null | no | Render visibility. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.visibility --args '{"editor":"off","nodes":[1],"render":"default"}'`

### `object.enable`

Enable. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | yes |  |
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Nodes to change; the current selection when absent. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge object.enable --args '{"enabled":false,"nodes":[1]}'`


## `edit`

### `edit.undo`

Undo. Not an undoable edit.

No arguments.

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge edit.undo --args '{}'`

### `edit.redo`

Redo. Not an undoable edit.

No arguments.

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge edit.redo --args '{}'`

### `edit.soft_selection`

Soft Selection. Not an undoable edit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `curve` | array of number | no |  |
| `distance` | `"volume"` \| `"surface"` | no |  |
| `enabled` | boolean | no |  |
| `falloff` | `"linear"` \| `"dome"` \| `"bell"` \| `"spline"` | no |  |
| `radius` | number | no |  |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge edit.soft_selection --args '{"enabled":true,"falloff":"bell","radius":100.0}'`

### `edit.symmetry`

Symmetry. Not an undoable edit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `axis` | `"x"` \| `"y"` \| `"z"` | no |  |
| `enabled` | boolean | no |  |
| `offset` | number | no |  |
| `tolerance` | number | no |  |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge edit.symmetry --args '{"axis":"x","enabled":true}'`

## `select`

### `select.mode`

Selection Mode. Not an undoable edit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"model"` \| `"points"` \| `"edges"` \| `"polys"` | yes | What viewport clicks select (mirrors the editor's `EditMode`). |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge select.mode --args '{"mode":"points"}'`

### `select.all`

Select All. One undo step.

No arguments.

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge select.all --args '{}'`

### `select.none`

Deselect All. One undo step.

No arguments.

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge select.none --args '{}'`

### `select.invert`

Invert Selection. One undo step.

No arguments.

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge select.invert --args '{}'`

### `select.grow`

Grow Selection. One undo step.

No arguments.

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge select.grow --args '{}'`

### `select.shrink`

Shrink Selection. One undo step.

No arguments.

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge select.shrink --args '{}'`

### `select.connected`

Select Connected. One undo step.

No arguments.

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge select.connected --args '{}'`

### `select.convert`

Convert Selection. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `to` | `"model"` \| `"points"` \| `"edges"` \| `"polys"` | yes | Element kind to convert to: points, edges or polys (not model). |
| `mode` | string \| string | no | `strict` (default): all parts selected; `tolerant`: any part. Default: `"strict"`. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge select.convert --args '{"mode":"strict","to":"polys"}'`

### `select.loop`

Loop Selection. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `across` | integer | no | Polygons only: which edge pair of a quad the strip crosses (0 or 1, default 0). Default: `0`. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge select.loop --args '{"across":0}'`

### `select.ring`

Ring Selection. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `across` | integer | no | Polygons only: which edge pair of a quad the strip crosses (0 or 1, default 0). Default: `0`. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge select.ring --args '{"across":0}'`


## `transform`

### `transform.set`

Set Transform. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | integer | yes |  |
| `pos` | array of number (length 3) or null | no | Position `[x, y, z]`. |
| `rot` | array of number (length 3) or null | no | Rotation `[h, p, b]` in degrees. |
| `scale` | array of number (length 3) or null | no | Scale `[x, y, z]`. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge transform.set --args '{"node":1,"pos":[0.0,100.0,0.0],"rot":[90.0,0.0,0.0],"scale":[1.0,1.0,1.0]}'`

| `points` | array of integer or null | no | Point indices (point mode). |

### `mesh.loop_cut`

Loop Cut. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `edge` | integer \| array of integer (length 2) | yes | Edge id of the mesh, or a point pair [a, b] of an existing edge. |
| `count` | integer or null | no | Evenly spaced cuts instead of offsets (default 1 when neither is given). |
| `node` | integer or null | no | Polygon object; the active node when absent. |
| `offsets` | array of number or null | no | Cut positions as fractions (0..1, exclusive) along the edge, which runs from its lower to its higher point. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge mesh.loop_cut --args '{"edge":0,"offsets":[0.5]}'`

### `mesh.knife`

Knife. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"line"` \| `"plane"` \| `"loop"` | yes |  |
| `direction` | array of number (length 3) | no | line mode: the view direction (parallel view); or eye |
| `edge` | integer \| array of integer (length 2) | no | Edge id of the mesh, or a point pair [a, b] of an existing edge. |
| `eye` | array of number (length 3) | no | line mode: the viewer's position (perspective); or direction |
| `from` | array of number (length 3) | no | line mode: start of the drawn segment (object space) |
| `node` | integer or null | no | Polygon object; the active node when absent. |
| `normal` | array of number (length 3) | no | plane mode: the plane normal |
| `offset` | number | no | loop mode: position along the edge (default 0.5). |
| `point` | array of number (length 3) | no | plane mode: a point of the plane (object space) |
| `polys` | array of integer or null | no | Polygons to cut (plane and line modes); all when absent. |
| `to` | array of number (length 3) | no | line mode: end of the drawn segment |
| `visible_only` | boolean | no | line mode: skip polygons facing away (default true). |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge mesh.knife --args '{"mode":"plane","normal":[1.0,0.0,0.0],"point":[0.0,0.0,0.0]}'`

### `mesh.bridge`

Bridge. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `edges` | array of integer \| array of integer (length 2) (length 2) or null | no | Two border edges (id or point pair); each stands for its whole border loop. Give edges or polys. |
| `node` | integer or null | no | Polygon object; the active node when absent. |
| `polys` | array of integer (length 2) or null | no | Two polygons of the same size: they are removed and their outlines bridged. Give edges or polys. |
| `segments` | integer or null | no | Rows of quads between the loops (default 1). |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge mesh.bridge --args '{"polys":[0,1],"segments":1}'`

### `mesh.close_hole`

Close Polygon Hole. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `edge` | integer \| array of integer (length 2) | yes | Edge id of the mesh, or a point pair [a, b] of an existing edge. |
| `node` | integer or null | no | Polygon object; the active node when absent. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge mesh.close_hole --args '{"edge":0}'`

### `mesh.stitch`

Stitch and Sew. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `edges` | array of array of integer \| array of integer (length 2) (length 2) or null | no | Pairs of border edges [e1, e2] (id or point pair) to sew together. Give points or edges. |
| `node` | integer or null | no | Polygon object; the active node when absent. |
| `points` | array of array of integer (length 2) or null | no | Point pairs [a, b] to merge (into the lowest index of each set). Give points or edges. |
| `position` | `"middle"` \| `"first"` \| `null` | no | Where merged points go (default middle). |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge mesh.stitch --args '{"points":[[0,1]],"position":"middle"}'`

### `mesh.pen`

Polygon Pen. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `corners` | array of object \| object | yes | One corner adds a point, three or more add a polygon. A corner is {point: index} (an existing point) or {pos: [x, y, z]} (a new point, object space). |
| `node` | integer or null | no | Polygon object; the active node when absent. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge mesh.pen --args '{"corners":[{"pos":[0.0,0.0,0.0]},{"pos":[1.0,0.0,0.0]},{"pos":[0.0,1.0,0.0]}]}'`

### `mesh.transform`

Transform Components. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `move` | array of number (length 3) | no | Translation in object space. |
| `node` | integer or null | no | Polygon object; the active node when absent. |
| `pivot` | array of number (length 3) | no | Pivot, object space; the mean of the selected points when absent. |
| `points` | array of integer or null | no | Point ids; the stored selection of the current mode (points, points of the edges or of the polygons) when absent. |
| `rotate` | object | no | Rotation about the pivot, angle in degrees. |
| `scale` | number \| array of number (length 3) | no | Scale about the pivot: one number or [x, y, z]. |
| `soft` | boolean \| object | no | false: off, true: on with the editor settings, object: on with these values over the editor settings. Absent: the editor setting. |
| `symmetry` | boolean \| object | no | As soft, for the symmetry plane. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge mesh.transform --args '{"move":[0.0,10.0,0.0],"points":[0],"soft":{"falloff":"bell","radius":100.0},"symmetry":{"axis":"x"}}'`


## `param`

### `param.set`

Set Parameter. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | integer | yes |  |
| `param` | string | yes | Parameter id. |
| `value` | any | yes | Bool, number, `[x, y, z]`, string, node id or null, or an array of indices. Angles are degrees and percentages are as shown (50 is 50 %). |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge param.set --args '{"node":1,"param":"size","value":2.5}'`

### `param.edit`

Edit Parameter. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `param` | string | yes | Parameter id. |
| `value` | any | yes | As for `param.set` (degrees, percent as shown). With `component`, one number. |
| `component` | integer or null | no | Vec3 parameters only: set just this component (0, 1, 2) and keep the others of each object. |
| `gesture` | integer or null | no | Edits with the same gesture number merge into one undo step (a scrub or colour drag). |
| `nodes` | array of integer or null | no | Objects to edit; absent means the current selection. Objects whose type lacks the parameter (or has it with another kind) are skipped. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge param.edit --args '{"gesture":1,"nodes":[1],"param":"size","value":2.5}'`


## `key`

### `key.record`

Record. One undo step.

No arguments.

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge key.record --args '{}'`

### `key.delete_at_frame`

Delete Keys. One undo step.

No arguments.

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge key.delete_at_frame --args '{}'`

### `key.jump`

Jump to Key. Not an undoable edit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `forward` | boolean | yes | true: next key, false: previous key. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge key.jump --args '{"forward":true}'`

### `key.set`

Set Key. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | integer | yes |  |
| `track` | string | yes | Track: an animatable float parameter id, or `<vec3 param>.<x\|y\|z>` (`transform.pos.x`, `transform.rot.y`, `transform.scale.z`). |
| `frame` | integer | yes | Frame of the key (any integer; fps comes from the project). |
| `value` | number | yes | Value in display units (degrees for angles, percent as shown). |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge key.set --args '{"frame":10,"node":1,"track":"transform.pos.x","value":100.0}'`

### `key.autokey`

Autokey. Not an undoable edit.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean or null | no | New state; the current one is flipped when absent. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge key.autokey --args '{"enabled":true}'`

Go to Frame. Not an undoable edit.

Step Frames. Not an undoable edit.

Play. Not an undoable edit.

No arguments.

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge timeline.play --args '{}'`

### `timeline.stop`

Stop. Not an undoable edit.

No arguments.

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge timeline.stop --args '{}'`

### `timeline.settings`

Timeline Settings. One undo step.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fps` | integer | yes | Frames per second, 1 to 240. |
| `start` | integer | yes | First frame of the project range. |
| `end` | integer | yes | Last frame of the project range. |

Example: `forge cmd scene.forge timeline.settings --args '{"end":90,"fps":30,"start":0}'`
